name: Nugget Slugs
summary: At the Sludge Fen, Wenikee Boltbucket needs parts for a recovered samophlange. The eccentric tinkerer sends you to the nearby Venture Company drilling crews for spare hardware.

sections.title: Wenikee's Engineering Needs
sections.body: Wenikee Boltbucket has a recovered samophlange and wants to learn how the intricate machine works. Its goblin mechanisms need exact parts, so she sends you to the Venture Company crews at the Sludge Fen. Their heavy tool buckets hold the seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs she needs.

sections.title: A Volatile Breakthrough
sections.body: You gather fifteen nugget slugs while Venture Company operators and deforesters work the marsh east of the road. When you bring the parts back, Wenikee sets the samophlange on the ground and begins adjusting it at once. The mismatched parts and rushed assembly end in a sudden explosion. Wenikee is shaken, but her resolve to tinker holds.

faq.answer: A nugget slug is a small metal fastener or ammunition component used in goblin engineering. Wenikee needs seventeen-point-five gauge slugs for the delicate gears inside her samophlange.
Wenikee Boltbucket is an independent tinkerer camped beside the main trail in the northern Barrens. She is fascinated by intricate machines, especially samophlanges, despite the danger they bring.

faq.q: Where are the nugget slugs found?
faq.answer: You can find nugget slugs in tool buckets at the Sludge Fen, a Venture Company camp east of Wenikee's small roadside campsite. The company works there logging and extracting oil.

faq.q: What happens when Wenikee repairs the samophlange?
faq.answer: When Wenikee begins adjusting the samophlange with the parts you bring, the machine overloads and explodes in front of her. The poorly calibrated machine proves dangerous.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company at the Sludge Fen?
faq.answer: The Venture Company works at the Sludge Fen to strip-mine the Barrens marshes and extract oil and other natural resources. Its drill rigs and refineries pollute the surrounding landscape.

faq.q: Does this quest unlock any further tasks?
faq.answer: After the repair attempt goes badly, Wenikee sends you to Orgrimmar to consult Rilli Greasygob, a former Venture Company engineer. She names the next task Rilli Greasygob.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize the warning signs of goblin handiwork before Wenikee's rushed repairs end in an explosion.
As a member of the Horde, you know the Venture Company's work at the Sludge Fen harms the marshes. Stealing its supplies gives you reason to strike back.
